')

curl -s $B/api/password-reset/$H2/identity; echo
EOF
bash /tmp/smoke.sh

Done. The `find -newer` hit on `application.properties` is just an mtime artifact from image prep — I only edited `PasswordResetService.java` (read-only access to everything else).

## Summary

Reconstructed the single `<MASKED>` region in `src/main/java/com/secureid/platform/service/PasswordResetService.java` as the complete `@Service` class with the required six-arg constructor and four public methods, matching the retained imports and `AuthService` conventions:

- `requestReset(username)` — 404 `用户不存在` for unknown users; otherwise persists a RESET-type 6-digit code (10-min expiry), emails it via `EmailService.sendVerificationCode` with subject `SecureID 密码重置验证码`, persists a token row (fresh UUID htoken, null resetToken, unused, 30-min expiry), and returns 200 `重置验证码已发送到绑定邮箱` with `htoken` and masked email (`us***@secureid.com` shape: first two local-part chars + `***` + `@domain`).
- `verifyCode(username, code)` — 404 unknown user, 400 `验证码无效或已过期` on no `findLatestValid` match, 400 `令牌无效或已过期` when the latest unused token is missing or expired (`expiredAt` strictly before now); on success writes a fresh UUID into the record's `reset_token` and returns 200 `验证成功` with it.
- `getIdentity(htoken)` — 400 `令牌无效或已过期` for missing/expired htoken, 404 `用户未完成实名认证` when no certification exists; otherwise 200 `查询成功` with `realName`, `idCardNumber`, `certified: true`.
- `confirmReset(resetToken, newPassword)` — 400 `重置令牌无效或已过期` for missing/used/expired tokens; otherwise stores the BCrypt encoding via `updatePassword`, marks the record used, returns 200 `密码重置成功` with null data.

Verification: `mvn package -DskipTests` compiles cleanly and produces `target/platform-1.0.0.jar`. I started the jar against the live MySQL/mailpit and ran a 14-step HTTP smoke test covering every contract branch — all responses matched the specified codes, messages, and data shapes, including the full chained flow (request → mailbox code → verify-code → identity → confirm → login with the new password) and the used-token/unknown-user/uncertified-user error paths. The test server was stopped and temp scripts removed afterward.
